title: Professional Email Cancellation Window and Refund Basis by Product
content:
Each Professional Email product sets how long the cancellation window of an annual term lasts and how a refund inside it is figured.

| Product | Cancellation window (elapsed hours from the start of an annual term) | Refund basis inside the window | Month-to-month charge ever refunded | Seat reduction outside the window takes effect | Added seats billed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline Mail Starter | 720 | full | No | at the next renewal | prorated daily to the term end |
| Harborline Mail Plus | 720 | full | No | at the next renewal | prorated daily to the term end |
| Harborline Mail Pro | 720 | full | No | at the next renewal | prorated daily to the term end |
| Microsoft 365 Business Basic | 168 | prorated daily | No | at the next renewal | prorated daily to the term end |
| Microsoft 365 Business Standard | 168 | prorated daily | No | at the next renewal | prorated daily to the term end |
| Microsoft 365 Business Premium | 168 | prorated daily | No | at the next renewal | prorated daily to the term end |

## What the columns mean

- The window is counted from the start of an annual term, whether that term began with the purchase or with a renewal; during it seats can be reduced, or the term cancelled, for a refund.
- **Full** means the refunded charge is returned in full; **prorated daily** means it is returned for the unused days of the term.
- No product ever refunds a month-to-month charge.
- 720 hours are 30 days of 24 hours; 168 hours are 7 days of 24 hours.
